candidate.description: A candidate counterexample identified by computational exhaustive search. Independent replication and peer validation remain pending.

archive.description: Historical GitHub traffic is not yet archived in this JSON file. GitHub traffic itself is limited to a rolling 14-day window.

publications.title: A Computational Audit of a Candidate Counterexample to Sun's (2,4,6,8) Conjecture: Exhaustive Verification and Cantor-Pascal Diagnostics

records.title: A Computational Audit of a Candidate Counterexample to Sun's (2,4,6,8) Conjecture: Exhaustive Verification and Cantor-Pascal Diagnostics

reach_events.definition: Platform-level access events reported by the respective platforms.
reach_events.formula: GitHub views + ResearchGate reads + Zenodo views + OSF views
reach_events.interpretation: These are platform events and must not be interpreted as unique researchers.

engagement_events.interpretation: This is an event-based engagement indicator, not a deduplicated count of individuals.

verification_events.definition: Research-related actions indicating activity beyond passive viewing.
verification_events.formula: GitHub clones + GitHub forks + Zenodo downloads + OSF downloads
verification_events.interpretation: These actions do not constitute independent scientific verification.

validation_events.definition: Evidence providing stronger external confirmation of the research claim.
validation_events.interpretation: Only independently documented validation events are included.

deduplication.description: Cross-platform users cannot currently be deduplicated. Therefore platform-level events are reported rather than unique individuals.

github_traffic.description: GitHub traffic metrics represent the platform's available rolling traffic window and should not be interpreted as lifetime traffic.
